posts.instagram:
Date night ideas running thin? Try a slow one at home.

Rhythms of Love is a 300-piece jigsaw puzzle of a couple dancing close, wrapped in bright swirls of color. It's frameable when finished, at about 17.9 by 14 inches.

Clear the table, put on a playlist and build it together, one swirl at a time. It's also a sweet anniversary or wedding gift for a couple who loves to dance.
